pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with diffuse, soft-gradient edges. Spatial area is significantly higher on the mid-flank, with geometry ranging from sub-rectangular to elongated ovoids.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, widening at intersection nodes and narrowing between large flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. Visible as a dense, short-cropped fringe of reddish-brown pixels against the sky background along the visible cervical and shoulder ridge.
